newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent edges up, Iraq food plan hours away.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent edges up, Iraq food plan hours away.

text.p: August Brent futures rose slightly on Tuesday, supported by modest gains on NYMEX, but the United Nations could receive Iraq's aid distribution plan within hours.
August rose to $18.21 per barrel, up two cents from London's close. At the same time NYMEX August crude, trading on ACCESS, was last traded at $19.60, up eight cents from New York.

But brokers said news Iraq was planning to shortly present a food distribution plan to the U.N. could limit upside potential. The market has been nervous about the timing of the plan -- which affects the timing of oil sales -- for some days.
Market activity might be limited ahead of the API weekly data which is due for release later on Tuesday.
